title: "Figure 4 – Collecting Duct cell analysis across timepoints"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2026-06-01"
output: html_document
description: 
  (B) UMAP of CD subsets (ICA, ICB, PC, hIC-PC).
  (C) Proportion of CD subsets across timepoints (0, 3, 7, 28 dpi).
  (D) DotPlot of canonical CD subset markers.
  (E) UMAPs of CD cells split by timepoint; spatial feature plots of deconvoluted PC, ICA, ICB, and hIC-PC proportions across timepoints.

  (J) PROGENy pathway activity heatmap across CD subsets and timepoints.

  (B) Feature plots split by timepoint, colored by Atp6v1g3 (IC), Aqp6 (ICA), Slc26a4 (ICB), Aqp2 (PC). 
  (C) CytoTRACE differentiation state analysis across CD subsets and timepoints.
  (D) Monocle3 pseudotime trajectory of CD cells.
  (E) Dotplot of Chemotactic factors (chemokines, cytokines) across CD subsets and timepoints.

## Load data

```{r load-data}
# Single-cell CD object (ICA / ICB / PC / hIC-PC annotated)
CDcells <- readRDS(paste0(SCIndir, "ICPCcells_DegCD_v02142025.RDS"))
CDcells <- UpdateSeuratObject(CDcells)

# Rename "DegCD" annotation to "hIC-PC"
CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot[CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot == "DegCD"] <- "hIC-PC"

# Ordered CD subset levels
subset_order    <- c("ICA", "ICB", "PC", "hIC-PC")
timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")

# Set identity to CD subset annotation
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)

cat("CD subset counts:\n")
print(table(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot))
cat("Timepoints:\n")
print(table(CDcells@meta.data$DataSet))
```

## Shared setup

```{r shared-setup}
# Combined subset × timepoint identity (used in H, I, J, K)
CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint <- paste(
  CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot,
  CDcells@meta.data$DataSet,
  sep = "_"
)

combined_order <- paste(
  rep(subset_order, each = length(timepoint_order)),
  timepoint_order,
  sep = "_"
)
combined_order <- combined_order[combined_order %in% unique(CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint)]

# Canonical CD marker gene sets
ICA_markers  <- c("Atp6v1g3", "Aqp6", "Slc4a1", "Slc26a7", "Kit")
ICB_markers  <- c("Slc26a4", "Spink8", "Hmx2")
PC_markers   <- c("Aqp2", "Hsd11b2", "Scnn1g", "Syt7")
canonical_cd <- c(ICA_markers, ICB_markers, PC_markers)
```

## Figure 4C: Proportion of CD subsets across timepoints (For this we manually corrected with each timepoint's total cell count, as the number of cells per timepoint is not equal)

```{r fig4c-proportion, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
prop_df <- table(CDcells@meta.data$DataSet, CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Timepoint = Var1, Subset = Var2) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(pct = prop.table(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = timepoint_order),
    Subset    = factor(Subset,    levels = subset_order)
  )

Fig4B_Prop <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = pct, fill = Subset)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Proportion", title = "CD subset proportions across timepoints") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4B_CD_Proportion.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4B_Prop,
  width    = 4, height = 4
)
Fig4C_Prop
```

```{r load-spatial}
)
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- UpdateSeuratObject(Pyelonephritis_Infection)

# for selected slices

names(timepoint_labels) <- spatial_slices

  slice1 = 1800, slice3 = 1800, slice4 = 1600,
  slice7 = 1600, slice8 = 1800, slice9 = 1800

colnames(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data)[colnames(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data) == "DegCD"] <- "hIC-PC"
```

## Figure 4E (spatial): Deconvoluted CD subset proportions across timepoints

```{r fig4e-spatial-deconv, fig.width=15, fig.height=3}
deconv_palette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))

deconv_cd <- subset_order[subset_order %in% colnames(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data)]
missing_cd <- setdiff(subset_order, deconv_cd)
if (length(missing_cd) > 0) {
  warning("Deconvolution columns not found in spatial meta.data: ",
          paste(missing_cd, collapse = ", "))
}

for (ct in deconv_cd) {
  # Shared color limits across all timepoints for this cell type
  ct_max <- max(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data[[ct]], na.rm = TRUE)

  Fig4E_Deconv <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    features       = ct,
    images         = spatial_slices,
    pt.size.factor = 1600,
    crop           = TRUE
  ) &
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = deconv_palette(4),
      limits  = c(0, ct_max),
      name    = ct
    )

  # Label each panel with its timepoint (panels follow the order of spatial_slices)
  for (i in seq_along(spatial_slices)) {
    Fig4E_Deconv[[i]] <- Fig4E_Deconv[[i]] +
      ggtitle(timepoint_labels[[spatial_slices[i]]]) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4E_Spatial_Deconvolution_", ct, ".pdf"),
    plot     = Fig4E_Deconv,
    height   = 3,
    width    = 15
  )
  print(Fig4E_Deconv)
}
```

## Figure 4E (markers): hIC-PC marker score across timepoints

The CD-only DEGs (hIC-PC vs ICA/ICB/PC) are dominated by proximal-tubule genes
(Aldob, Pck1, Miox, Slc34a1, ...), which light up the whole cortex on the spatial
slides. Here we (1) re-select hIC-PC markers against **all** kidney cell types in
the full atlas, (2) keep only genes whose mean expression in hIC-PC clearly
exceeds every other cell type (incl. PT), then (3) plot a module score of those
genes on the spatial slides, with and without masking to CD-containing spots.

```{r fig4e-hicpc-marker-select}
AtlasIndir <- "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/Integrated_EpiStroImmCells_v020426/"
SCatlas <- readRDS(paste0(AtlasIndir, "PIPSeq_Final_UsedForScanpy_v08212026.RDS"))
SCatlas <- UpdateSeuratObject(SCatlas)
SCatlas$AnnotationL1[SCatlas$AnnotationL1 == "DegCD"] <- "hIC-PC"

DefaultAssay(SCatlas) <- "RNA"
if (inherits(SCatlas[["RNA"]], "Assay5")) SCatlas[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(SCatlas[["RNA"]])
Idents(SCatlas) <- "AnnotationL1"

# (1) hIC-PC vs all other kidney cell types
hicpc_vs_all <- FindMarkers(
  SCatlas,
  ident.1             = "hIC-PC",
  only.pos            = TRUE,
  logfc.threshold     = 0.5,
  min.pct             = 0.2,
  max.cells.per.ident = 1000   # downsample for speed
)
hicpc_vs_all$gene <- rownames(hicpc_vs_all)

# (2) Specificity: mean (non-log) expression in hIC-PC vs the highest other cell type
cand <- head(hicpc_vs_all$gene[hicpc_vs_all$p_val_adj < 0.05], 300)
expr <- expm1(GetAssayData(SCatlas, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[cand, , drop = FALSE])
grp_cells <- split(colnames(SCatlas), SCatlas$AnnotationL1)
avg_by_type <- sapply(grp_cells, function(cells) Matrix::rowMeans(expr[, cells, drop = FALSE]))

other_types <- setdiff(colnames(avg_by_type), "hIC-PC")
hicpc_vs_all$max_other_type <- NA
hicpc_vs_all$specificity    <- NA
hicpc_vs_all[cand, "max_other_type"] <- other_types[apply(avg_by_type[, other_types, drop = FALSE], 1, which.max)]
hicpc_vs_all[cand, "specificity"]    <- avg_by_type[, "hIC-PC"] /
  apply(avg_by_type[, other_types, drop = FALSE], 1, max)

write.csv(hicpc_vs_all, paste0(Outdir, "Figure4E_hICPC_vs_AllCelltypes_Markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Thresholds -- relax these if too few genes pass
min_pct1        <- 0.30   # expressed in >= 30% of hIC-PC cells
max_pct2        <- 0.15   # expressed in <= 15% of all other cells
min_specificity <- 1.5    # hIC-PC mean >= 1.5x the next highest cell type

hicpc_markers <- hicpc_vs_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(specificity),
                pct.1 >= min_pct1, pct.2 <= max_pct2, specificity >= min_specificity) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  head(20)

cat("hIC-PC-specific markers passing filters:", nrow(hicpc_markers), "\n")
print(hicpc_markers[, c("gene", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1", "pct.2", "specificity", "max_other_type")])

# Check: how the candidates look across ALL kidney cell types
if (nrow(hicpc_markers) > 0) {
  Fig4E_hICPC_AtlasDot <- DotPlot(SCatlas, features = hicpc_markers$gene,
                                  cols = c("lightgrey", "#E31A1C"), dot.scale = 6) +
    RotatedAxis() + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
  ggsave(paste0(Outdir, "Figure4E_hICPC_Markers_AtlasDotPlot.pdf"),
         Fig4E_hICPC_AtlasDot, width = 8, height = 5)
  print(Fig4E_hICPC_AtlasDot)
}
```

```{r fig4e-hicpc-marker-spatial, fig.width=15, fig.height=3}
hicpc_genes <- hicpc_markers$gene[hicpc_markers$gene %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection[["SCT"]])]
stopifnot("No hIC-PC markers found in the spatial SCT assay -- relax the thresholds above" = length(hicpc_genes) >= 3)

DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- "SCT"
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- AddModuleScore(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection,
  features = list(hicpc_genes),
  name     = "hICPC_Score",
  assay    = "SCT"
)

# Cap at 1st/99th percentile so a few hot spots don't flatten the color scale
sc <- Pyelonephritis_Infection$hICPC_Score1
lims <- quantile(sc, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
Pyelonephritis_Infection$hICPC_Score_capped <- pmin(pmax(sc, lims[1]), lims[2])

# Masked version: keep the score only in spots with a CD signal in the deconvolution
cd_frac_min <- 0.10   # total ICA+ICB+PC+hIC-PC proportion required
cd_total <- rowSums(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data[, deconv_cd, drop = FALSE])
Pyelonephritis_Infection$hICPC_Score_CDmasked <- ifelse(
  cd_total >= cd_frac_min, Pyelonephritis_Infection$hICPC_Score_capped, NA
)

plot_spatial_score <- function(feature, file_tag) {
  p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    features       = feature,
    images         = spatial_slices,
    pt.size.factor = 1600,
    crop           = TRUE
  ) &
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours  = deconv_palette(4),
      limits   = lims,
      na.value = "grey90",
      name     = "hIC-PC\nscore"
    )
  for (i in seq_along(spatial_slices)) {
    p[[i]] <- p[[i]] +
      ggtitle(timepoint_labels[[spatial_slices[i]]]) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))
  }
  ggsave(paste0(Outdir, "Figure4E_Spatial_hICPC_", file_tag, ".pdf"), p, height = 3, width = 15)
  print(p)
}

plot_spatial_score("hICPC_Score_capped",   "MarkerScore")
plot_spatial_score("hICPC_Score_CDmasked", "MarkerScore_CDmasked")

# Agreement with the deconvolution estimate
cat("Spearman correlation, marker score vs hIC-PC deconvolution proportion:",
    round(cor(sc, Pyelonephritis_Infection$`hIC-PC`, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3), "\n")
```

## Figure 4F: Spatial feature plots of representative CD markers across timepoints

```{r fig4f-spatial-features, fig.width=15, fig.height=3}
spatial_cd_markers <- c("Atp6v1g3", "Slc4a1", "Slc26a4", "Aqp2","Aqp6", "Ass1","Ttc36","Pck1")
myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))

for (m in spatial_cd_markers) {
  skip_to_next <- FALSE
  tryCatch(
    print(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]),
    error = function(e) { skip_to_next <<- TRUE }
  )
  if (skip_to_next) next

  Maxvalue <- ceiling(max(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]))
  Minvalue <- floor(min(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]))

  CDMarkerSpatialFeature <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    features       = m,
    pt.size.factor = 1600,
    crop           = TRUE
  ) &
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = myPalette(4),
      limits  = c(Minvalue, Maxvalue+0.5)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4F_Spatial_", m, "_CDMarker.pdf"),
    plot     = CDMarkerSpatialFeature,
    height   = 3,
    width    = 15
  )
}


```

### Figure 4F (colocalization): Atp6v1g3 / Aqp2 / Ttc36

```{r fig4f-spatial-coloc, fig.width=15, fig.height=3}
coloc_genes <- c(R = "Atp6v1g3", G = "Aqp2", B = "Ttc36")
coloc_genes <- coloc_genes[coloc_genes %in% rownames(Pyelonephritis_Infection)]
stopifnot(length(coloc_genes) == 3)

coloc_expr <- t(as.matrix(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[coloc_genes, , drop = FALSE]))

# Scale each gene to 0-1 across all slices (cap at 99th percentile so a few hot spots don't dominate)
scale01 <- function(x) {
  cap <- quantile(x, 0.99)
  if (cap == 0) cap <- max(x)
  pmin(x / cap, 1)
}
coloc_scaled <- apply(coloc_expr, 2, scale01)

# --- (0) SpatialFeaturePlot of each gene (same style as above), stacked into one PDF
CDMarkerFeatureList <- lapply(coloc_genes, function(m) {
  Maxvalue <- ceiling(max(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]))
  Minvalue <- floor(min(Pyelonephritis_Infection@assays$SCT@data[m, ]))

  SpatialFeaturePlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    features       = m,
    pt.size.factor = 1600,
    crop           = TRUE
  ) &
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = myPalette(4),
      limits  = c(Minvalue, Maxvalue+0.5)
    )
})
Fig4F_CDMarkers <- wrap_plots(CDMarkerFeatureList, ncol = 1)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4F_Spatial_CDMarkers.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4F_CDMarkers,
  height   = 3 * length(coloc_genes),
  width    = 15
)

# --- (1) RGB overlay: Atp6v1g3 = red, Aqp2 = green, Ttc36 = blue
#     overlap -> yellow (Atp6v1g3+Aqp2), magenta (Atp6v1g3+Ttc36), cyan (Aqp2+Ttc36), white (all three)
coloc_hex <- rgb(
  round(coloc_scaled[, 1], 2),
  round(coloc_scaled[, 2], 2),
  round(coloc_scaled[, 3], 2)
)
Pyelonephritis_Infection$Coloc_RGB <- coloc_hex
rgb_cols <- setNames(unique(coloc_hex), unique(coloc_hex))

Fig4F_RGB <- SpatialDimPlot(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection,
  group.by       = "Coloc_RGB",
  cols           = rgb_cols,
  pt.size.factor = 1600,
  image.alpha    = 0,
  crop           = TRUE
) &
  NoLegend() &
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", colour = NA))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4F_Spatial_Coloc_RGB_",
                    paste(coloc_genes, collapse = "_"), ".pdf"),
  plot = Fig4F_RGB, height = 3, width = 15
)
Fig4F_RGB

# --- (2) Categorical co-expression map on H&E
#     a spot is "positive" for a gene if expression > median of its non-zero values
coloc_thresh <- apply(coloc_expr, 2, function(x) median(x[x > 0]))
coloc_pos    <- sweep(coloc_expr, 2, coloc_thresh, ">")

coloc_class <- apply(coloc_pos, 1, function(p) {
  if (!any(p)) "None" else paste(coloc_genes[p], collapse = "+")
})
coloc_levels <- c(
  coloc_genes[1], coloc_genes[2], coloc_genes[3],
  paste(coloc_genes[c(1, 2)], collapse = "+"),
  paste(coloc_genes[c(1, 3)], collapse = "+"),
  paste(coloc_genes[c(2, 3)], collapse = "+"),
  paste(coloc_genes, collapse = "+"),
  "None"
)
coloc_class_cols <- setNames(
  c("#E41A1C", "#4DAF4A", "#377EB8", "#FFD700", "#E7298A", "#00CED1", "#000000", "#F0F0F0"),
  coloc_levels
)
Pyelonephritis_Infection$Coloc_Class <- factor(coloc_class, levels = coloc_levels)

Fig4F_Class <- SpatialDimPlot(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection,
  group.by       = "Coloc_Class",
  cols           = coloc_class_cols,
  pt.size.factor = 1600,
  crop           = TRUE
)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4F_Spatial_Coloc_Class_",
                    paste(coloc_genes, collapse = "_"), ".pdf"),
  plot = Fig4F_Class, height = 3, width = 15
)
Fig4F_Class

# Spot counts per co-expression class and slice (for figure legend / text)
coloc_counts <- sapply(Images(Pyelonephritis_Infection), function(img) {
  table(Pyelonephritis_Infection$Coloc_Class[Cells(Pyelonephritis_Infection[[img]])])
})
coloc_counts
write.csv(coloc_counts, paste0(Outdir, "Figure4F_Spatial_Coloc_Class_Counts.csv"))
```

## Figure 4G: DotPlot of CD subset markers by timepoint (differentiation & transport)

```{r fig4g-dotplot-subset-timepoint, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint, levels = combined_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "RNA"

transport_stress_markers <- c(
  # ICA identity / v-ATPase
  "Atp6v1g3", "Atp6v0d2", "Atp6v1b1", "Aqp6", "Slc4a1", "Slc26a7", "Foxi1",
  # ICB identity
  "Slc26a4", "Spink8", "Hmx2",
  # PC identity / water channel
  "Aqp2", "Aqp3", "Hsd11b2", "Scnn1g", "Avpr2"
  # Renal injury / stress
 # "Havcr1", "Vcam1", "Lcn2", "Vim", "Umod", "Igfbp7","C3","Il18","S100a8","S100a9"
```

## Figure 4I: PROGENy pathway activity heatmap across CD subsets and timepoints

```{r fig4i-progeny, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint, levels = combined_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "RNA"

# Run PROGENy via decoupleR MLM
net_cd  <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = "mouse", top = 500)
mat_cd  <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(CDcells, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"))

acts_cd <- run_mlm(
  mat     = mat_cd,
  net     = net_cd,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor    = "weight",
  minsize = 5
)

CDcells[["pathwaysmlm_cd"]] <- acts_cd %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "source", names_from = "condition", values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("source") %>%
  Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "pathwaysmlm_cd"
CDcells <- ScaleData(CDcells)

# Average scaled activity per subset × timepoint
df_cd <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(CDcells, assay = "pathwaysmlm_cd", layer = "scale.data"))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(group = Idents(CDcells)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -group, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(group, source) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

cd_acts_mat <- df_cd %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "group", names_from = "source", values_from = "mean") %>%
  column_to_rownames("group") %>%
  as.matrix()

PathwayOrder_cd <- c(
  "NFkB", "TNFa", "Hypoxia", "JAK-STAT",
  "Trail", "p53",
  "MAPK", "EGFR", "PI3K", "VEGF",
  "TGFb", "WNT", "Estrogen"
)
PathwayOrder_cd <- PathwayOrder_cd[PathwayOrder_cd %in% colnames(cd_acts_mat)]
groups_present  <- combined_order[combined_order %in% rownames(cd_acts_mat)]

CDHeatmapMat <- t(cd_acts_mat)[PathwayOrder_cd, groups_present]

palette_length <- 100
cd_color  <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"))(palette_length)
cd_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0,   length.out = ceiling(palette_length / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 1, length.out = floor(palette_length / 2)))

Fig4I_Progeny <- pheatmap(
  CDHeatmapMat,
  fontsize       = 7,
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  color          = cd_color,
  breaks         = cd_breaks,
  #main           = "PROGENy pathway activity – CD subsets × timepoints",
  angle_col      = 45,
  border_color   = NA,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  treeheight_row = 0
)

pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4I_CD_PROGENy_Heatmap.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5)
print(Fig4I_Progeny)
dev.off()
```

### Figure 4I (per subset): PROGENy activity scaled within each CD subset

```{r fig4i-progeny-per-subset, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
# Scaling across all CD cells lets PC dominate the color range.
# Here PROGENy scores are z-scored within each subset, averaged per timepoint,
# and plotted with a subset-specific symmetric color scale.
progeny_raw <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(CDcells, assay = "pathwaysmlm_cd", layer = "data"))

subsets_split <- c("ICA", "ICB", "hIC-PC")
Fig4I_subset_heatmaps <- list()

for (s in subsets_split) {
  cells_s <- colnames(CDcells)[CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot == s]
  if (length(cells_s) == 0) next

  # z-score each pathway across cells of this subset only
  scaled_s <- t(scale(t(progeny_raw[, cells_s, drop = FALSE])))
  scaled_s[is.na(scaled_s)] <- 0

  tp_s <- factor(CDcells@meta.data[cells_s, "DataSet"], levels = timepoint_order)
  mean_s <- sapply(levels(droplevels(tp_s)), function(tp) {
    rowMeans(scaled_s[, tp_s == tp, drop = FALSE])
  })
  colnames(mean_s) <- paste(s, colnames(mean_s), sep = "_")
  mean_s <- mean_s[PathwayOrder_cd, , drop = FALSE]

  # subset-specific symmetric scale around 0
  lim_s    <- max(abs(mean_s))
  breaks_s <- seq(-lim_s, lim_s, length.out = palette_length + 1)

  Fig4I_subset_heatmaps[[s]] <- pheatmap(
    mean_s,
    fontsize       = 7,
    fontsize_row   = 8,
    show_rownames  = TRUE,
    cluster_cols   = FALSE,
    cluster_rows   = FALSE,
    color          = cd_color,
    breaks         = breaks_s,
    main           = s,
    angle_col      = 45,
    border_color   = NA,
    silent         = TRUE
  )

  pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4I_CD_PROGENy_Heatmap_", s, ".pdf"), width = 3, height = 4)
  grid::grid.draw(Fig4I_subset_heatmaps[[s]]$gtable)
  dev.off()
}

# Combined panel: ICA | ICB | hIC-PC, each with its own scale
Fig4I_Progeny_PerSubset <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plotlist = lapply(Fig4I_subset_heatmaps, function(h) h$gtable),
  nrow = 1
)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure4I_CD_PROGENy_Heatmap_PerSubset.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig4I_Progeny_PerSubset,
  width    = 3 * length(Fig4I_subset_heatmaps),
  height   = 4
)
Fig4I_Progeny_PerSubset
```

## Figure S5C: Monocle3 pseudotime trajectory of CD cells

```{r figS5c-monocle3-pseudotime, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)

Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$ICPCAnnot, levels = subset_order)
DefaultAssay(CDcells) <- "RNA"

# Convert Seurat → Monocle3 CellDataSet (reuses Seurat UMAP embedding)
cds_cd <- as.cell_data_set(CDcells)

# Re-use the existing Seurat UMAP so trajectory overlays the same layout
cds_cd@int_colData$reducedDims$UMAP <- Embeddings(CDcells, "umap")[colnames(cds_cd), ]

# Cluster cells and learn trajectory graph across all CD subsets
cds_cd <- cluster_cells(cds_cd, reduction_method = "UMAP")
cds_cd <- learn_graph(cds_cd, use_partition = FALSE)

# Root trajectory at PC cells at 0DPI (most differentiated, homeostatic CD state)
get_cd_root_nodes <- function(cds_obj) {
  origin_cell_ids <- which(
    colData(cds_obj)$DataSet    == "0DPI" &
    colData(cds_obj)$ICPCAnnot %in% c("PC", "ICA")
  )
  closest_vertex <- cds_obj@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds_obj), ])
  root_nodes <- igraph::V(principal_graph(cds_obj)[["UMAP"]])$name[
    as.numeric(names(which.max(table(closest_vertex[origin_cell_ids, ]))))
  ]
  root_nodes
}
cds_cd <- order_cells(cds_cd, root_pr_nodes = get_cd_root_nodes(cds_cd))

# Store pseudotime in Seurat metadata for downstream plotting
CDcells$Pseudotime <- pseudotime(cds_cd)[colnames(CDcells)]

# Panel N1: UMAP colored by CD subset with trajectory graph
FigS5C_Subset <- plot_cells(
  cds_cd,
  color_cells_by      = "ICPCAnnot",
  label_cell_groups   = TRUE,
  label_leaves        = TRUE,
  label_branch_points = TRUE,
  graph_label_size    = 1.5,
  cell_size           = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "CD trajectory – subset") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

# Panel N2: UMAP colored by pseudotime
FigS5C_Pseudo <- plot_cells(
  cds_cd,
  color_cells_by      = "pseudotime",
  label_cell_groups   = FALSE,
  label_leaves        = FALSE,
  label_branch_points = FALSE,
  cell_size           = 0.5
) +
  #labs(title = "CD trajectory – pseudotime") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

# Panel N3: UMAP colored by timepoint
FigS5C_Time <- plot_cells(
  cds_cd,
  color_cells_by      = "DataSet",
  label_cell_groups   = FALSE,
  label_leaves        = FALSE,
  label_branch_points = FALSE,
  cell_size           = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "CD trajectory – timepoint") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))

FigS5C <- cowplot::plot_grid(FigS5C_Subset, FigS5C_Pseudo, FigS5C_Time, nrow = 1)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "FigureS5C_CD_Monocle3_Pseudotime.pdf"),
  plot     = FigS5C,
  width    = 14, height = 4
)
Fig4N
```

```{r}
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "CD subset"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_colorbar(title = "AveExp"),
    size   = guide_legend(title  = "PerExp")
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# save the figure
ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "FigureS5E_CD_NovelMarkers_DotPlot.pdf"),
  plot     = FigS5EChaemotacticFactorDotPlots,
  width    = 6, height = 3.5
)

```

# Generate the dotplot for Inflammatory marker expression across CD subsets and timepoints (Figure S5E, S5E)
```{r}
Idents(CDcells) <- factor(CDcells@meta.data$SubsetTimepoint, levels = combined_order)

  # Chemokines
  "Cxcl1", "Cxcl2", "Cxcl5", "Cxcl10", "Ccl2", "Ccl5",

  "Nfkb1", "Rela", "Nlrp3",

  "C3", "Nos2"
)

FigS5F_DotPlot <- DotPlot(

 #cols      = c("lightgrey", "#E31A1C"),

) +

ggsave(
```
